description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getSessionDurations and getCosts, which compute session durations and costs respectively, by querying MongoDB collections. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: getSessionDurations
methods.description: Calculates total session duration in minutes and provides breakdowns grouped by user and project, based on session tracking data.

methods.name: getCosts
methods.description: Calculates total costs and provides breakdowns grouped by user and project, based on LLM cost data.
